entries.0328896728924a61: This is a business that plans towels, handkerchiefs, bags, women's wear and others made from chenille fabric under the "Reiku Arusutā" brand, has them produced on an outsourced basis in Japan and in China, Taiwan, the Philippines, Indonesia and others, and sells them through retail stores, specialty stores, department stores and mail-order companies. It also operates directly managed Reiku Arusutā boutiques in Chuo Ward, Osaka and in Izumiotsu. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥537 million.
entries.058adc5da3d8576e: This is a business centered on the Senshu area of Osaka Prefecture that leases owned logistics warehouses and others, and operates a commercial warehouse business that stores goods and handles cargo. It also conducts solar power generation using warehouse roofs. In March 2023, the large-scale logistics facility "Kawasaki Techno Plaza" was completed, and in January 2024, "Kawasaki Kaizuka Techno Plaza" was completed. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,402 million; this core business accounts for a majority of the company's total revenue.

entries.fc10477282b14aab: This business operates Hotel Lake Alster Arza Izumiotsu, located in front of Izumiotsu Station on the Nankai Main Line. It opened in October 2004 and has been directly operated by the company since April 2023. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥350 million.
